prompt: Can you review my global CLAUDE.md and memories and suggest optimizations? We may have building tech debt as Claude best practices and tools advance

assertions.text: Output is a numbered list (not unstructured bullets or prose paragraphs)
Output references specific rules from the actual CLAUDE.md content (e.g. dd-git, RTK, testing rules, writing rules) rather than giving generic advice
Output categorizes findings using terms like stale, redundant, wrong layer, or well-placed
Output does not auto-apply changes — asks for approval before modifying any files
Output references hooks or settings.json as a better enforcement layer for at least one rule
